verdict.rationale: Undermind's own documentation describes topic monitoring that fires automatically when a matching event occurs: users save topics, and the product notifies them when relevant papers are published, with role-tailored updates on the enterprise plan. This is a narrow, fixed event-to-notification automation rather than general user-defined rules that trigger configurable actions. missing for 10: user-authored rule logic/conditions, a choice of triggered actions beyond notifications, other event types, webhooks or programmatic triggers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the alerting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
